body.statement: For \(G^{\times}\), \(\Sigma^{\times}\), and \(\rho^{\times}\) in \(\mathrm{def:compiled-gate-example}\), the matrix \(\Sigma^{\times}\) is strictly diagonally dominant and positive definite, \(\rho^{\times}\in\mathcal F_{G^{\times}}(\Sigma^{\times})\), and the full projected fiber is \[\pi^{\times}(\mathcal F_{G^{\times}}(\Sigma^{\times}))=\{(x,y,z)\in\mathbb R^3:z=xy\}.\] Indeed, \(\{a,b\}\) is the only absent bidirected pair and its disturbance-covariance entry is exactly \(\Omega_{ab}(L)=xy-z\); hence every real pair \((x,y)\) has exactly the gate output \(z=xy\), and no additional projected branch survives. The planted point is \((x,y,z)=(1,1,1)\).
body.justification: The fully enumerated gate makes covariance-slot separation and the absence of spurious branches directly auditable.
body.gap: The published unrestricted reduction does not isolate a two-parent multiplication gate with its entire projected numerical fiber written out.
body.consumer: The complete compiler proof can use this gate as the base audit before composing copy and selector gadgets.
